changelog: New spoken punctuation: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'arrow sign' or 'right arrow sign' (or 'তীর চিহ্ন' / 'অ্যারো চিহ্ন') while dictating and an arrow → appears — for steps, routes and before/after lines ('Dhaka arrow sign Narayanganj' → 'Dhaka → Narayanganj') instead of the words staying in your text. A bare 'arrow' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
